title: AI Skills Assessment for Employees: Codility Product Tour
text:
Take a 2-minute tour of AI skills assessment for business teams
Codility Skills Intelligence shows which of your employees can do their work with AI, from a task they complete with an AI Assistant. Follow one baseline from setup to the team view.
What you’ll see in the tour
10 steps through one AI skills baseline for sales, finance and operations teams, and one employee’s task from start to result.
One program for several business teams
Add the teams, choose a task from the business task library and set the dates. The library covers sales, marketing, finance, operations and customer roles, plus general tasks anyone can take.
A task close to the day-to-day job
Employees start from their own dashboard. The brief comes with spreadsheets and documents that open beside it, and an AI Assistant to work with.
Every prompt saved with the result
The AI Assistant stays on for these tasks. Every prompt and answer is saved, so you can see how each person checked the AI’s work.
Scored by fixed rules
Each response is scored against an answer key written by experts. Same work, same score, every time. No AI grades it.
Skills and proficiency for every employee
Results map to skills on 5 levels, from Novice to Expert, the same scale Skills Intelligence uses across your organization.
Who can do the work now, and who to upskill next
Compare teams that took the same task, see each person’s level, and add a second round after training.
